title: Repairs and Loaner Devices at the Campus Technology Desk, Student Technology Device Program
content:
For the Student Technology Device Program, a damaged device is taken in at the campus technology desk and repaired within 5 calendar days.

While it is in repair, the student receives a loaner device when the loan type provides a loaner during repair; the loaner is covered on the same terms as the device in repair.

The repair charge follows the program's damage charging rules whether or not the family accepts the repair.

## The statement in parts

| Subject | Standard |
|---|---|
| Where a damaged device is taken in | The campus technology desk |
| Repair time | Within 5 calendar days |
| Loaner while in repair | Issued when the loan type provides a loaner during repair |
| Terms of the loaner | The same terms as the device in repair |
| Repair charge | Follows the damage charging rules, whether or not the family accepts the repair |

## Basis questions

**Is the loaner covered by the Technology Protection Plan?** It is covered on the same terms as the device in repair: a loaner issued for a device on a plan loan type is covered as that device is; a loaner issued for a device on a standard-liability loan type is covered as that device is.

**Does a family that declines the repair avoid the repair charge?** No. The repair charge follows the damage charging rules whether or not the family accepts the repair.
